criteria: Default Project first; File/Create/Panels/Config/Help order and release version
Public begin pauses at frame zero; exact 30 real C# controlled frames move 1 unit; finish restores authored scene
Repeated real C#/Wasm fixed-step suites produce identical results
Known failing assertion is reported; real WebGPU pixel assertion passes
Public cancellation releases runtime/input and preserves authored source
Human Game Tests UI runs the same saved suite and displays assertions
Scene and Game render independent cameras simultaneously; popup keyboard controls one shared simulation; closing restores Game
Physical tab reorder, self-drop no-op, close/Panels reopen, persisted order and reset
Save icon precedes File; dirty asterisk and Ctrl+S work from Inspector
Ctrl+S from a detached Inspector field saves the owner project
Real Rust 3D collision assertions pass after exact 120 steps
Actual Wasm animator state and quaternion assertions pass
Null renderer explicitly fails pixel assertions without fabricated screenshot
